test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given, followed by four conclusions given in the options. Find out which conclusion is true based on the given statement.

Statement: L = U > V > E < Z < Q
solution: Given Statement: L = U > V > E Conclusions: Option 1: Q > V → False (V > E No definite relation can be possible between Q and V)
